answer: Each hollow, the identity an attacker spawns, needs spiral to act, one spiral being an epoch where judges score its output original. Spiral is non-transferable and accrues at most one per epoch. Work lands in the lagoon, a public index clustering near-duplicate output, and the k-th hollow in a cluster needs 10k spiral. An honest agent waits 10 epochs; 1,000 clones of one model need 5,005,000 judged epochs, or 1,000 truly distinct work styles. It breaks if judges pass paraphrases or the lagoon misses disguised duplicates.
